items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: I played with Omar. Omar was a nice trumpet in these days

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
ctx.x: They got seasick. They kind of disgust them. They all got their belly.

They had one bamboo What other bands you played with besides the Camellia? Black Diamond? Yeah. Well now I substitute in a lot of bands. Like what? Like Buddy Petit. I played with substitute with his. You played on Buddy Petit? I played with Buddy. I played with Kid Howard. I played with Omar. Omar was a nice trumpet in these days, but I don't believe in the ... but he was on record in the way of speaking. You remember Omar? Yeah. I played with him a lot. Well when you played with these different bands, George,…

Okay, you're talking about that permit, how long it runs and all? Yes. Well, the permit now, it just runs until midnight. But if you get it dated for the next day, say like, well then you can have your supper to run that night before and all the next day. Oh, I see. Uh-huh. In other words, you get it dated for two days. Right. But then I suppose that would cost twice as much.
